{{Short description|none}}
Depending on design requirements, some ships have extremely large internal volumes in order to serve their duties. [[Gross tonnage]] is a [[monotonic function|monotonic]] and [[injective function|1-to-1]] function of the ship's internal structural volume. It does not include removable objects placed outside the deck or superstructure, like the [[shipping container]]s of a container ship.
